stem:
Meera's class discussed daily habits and surroundings that support a healthy body and a healthy mind. Which of the following statements is incorrect ( )
A. Eating nutritious food and keeping the home and school surroundings clean support good health
B. Regular exercise and enough sleep every night help Meera stay healthy
C. Only physical fitness matters for health, so Meera's friendship with Aisha and a positive attitude do not count
D. Good personal hygiene, like washing hands before meals, protects the body from illness

options.text: Eating nutritious food and keeping the home and school surroundings clean support good health
Regular exercise and enough sleep every night help Meera stay healthy
Only physical fitness matters for health, so Meera's friendship with Aisha and a positive attitude do not count
Good personal hygiene, like washing hands before meals, protects the body from illness

teacher.key_rationale: C is the incorrect statement: health includes mental and social well-being, so supportive relationships and a positive attitude do count, not only physical fitness. A, B, and D correctly link food, cleanliness, activity, sleep, and hygiene to health.
